text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“I am Daiichi Ruby. I look forward to 
working with you starting today.”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Be magnificent. Be supreme. Always shine 
with the greatest brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I will simply forge ahead, carrying the 
creed of my clan in my heart. ...That is 
all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
